# Accent `refundrebel`

Link: `?firma=refundrebel`

refundrebel's site and platform use one strong royal blue. Since the neutral accent is already blue, the company gets a calm **teal** instead: cool, fresh, close to "money back", and clearly different from the neutral variant in a side-by-side comparison. No logo, font, image or text of the company is used; the only trace is the small "Demo für refundrebel" note in the header.

| Token | Light | Dark | Use |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| accent | `#0D8F86` | `#2CC4B5` | chart marks, icons, focus ring |
| accent-soft | `#DEF3F0` | `#122A29` | tinted surfaces, icon circles |
| accent-fg | `#0B6B64` | `#6FE0D3` | text and links in the accent |
| primary / hover | `#0F766E` / `#0C6660` | same | buttons, the "Zugesagt" card; white text 5.5:1 |
| chart-2 | `#6CC5BB` | `#A3E9E0` | second series |

Contrast for every pair is tested in `tests/unit/theme.test.ts`.
